cancellationPolicies.label: Free Cancellation rates
cancellationPolicies.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 23rd Nov 2025 (AEST) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 23rd Nov 2025 (AEST) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.

dorms.name: Standard 10 Bed Mixed Dorm Ensuite
dorms.description: Dormitory style and range in size from 2 beds upwards.  They offer mixed accommodation.
dorms.labelDescription:
10 Bed Share + 2 Ensuite is very roomy, light and airy.  Amazing shower facilities at a 1:5 ratio in a big dorm.  You won't believe the size of the room! Perfect space to meet lots of friends and great for group bookings.

A/C and equipped with USB port

paymentProcedure.label: Deposit only
paymentProcedure.description:
Deposit only
Your deposit will be non-refundable unless the Standard Flexible Booking option is available and you select it. T&C apply.
